title: New York City
summary: Team BlackSheep flies FPV (first-person view) model aircraft over New York City, past the Brooklyn and Verrazano bridges, lower Manhattan and the Statue of Liberty. The flights stirred controversy in the RC community.
why: HN cites it as a well-known early example of FPV drone flight in drone and regulation discussions.

quote.text: that video caused a _lot_ of controversy in the FPV (first person video) and RC community
